findings: Server.Close closes cleanup done channel and cache but does not cancel or clear registered searches; isolated lifecycle control confirms. Start uses bare http.ListenAndServe with no owned shutdown handle.
Search state has a consuming flag but handleResults does not enforce a single consumer. Multiple listeners can divide the result channel; source inspection only, no runtime concurrency control yet.
Cache scan uses synchronous cache.Scan without request cancellation propagation; callback writes do not check write errors. Source inspection, not an interruption latency measurement.
Uploaded source hash work precedes search context creation, which uses context.Background rather than request context. No runtime cancellation qualification for decode.

Testutil images are generated solids, gradients, checkerboards and red/green splits. Real EXIF helper writes one big-endian orientation=1 fixture; no eight-orientation pixel oracle. EncodeJPEG helpers discard encoding errors.
